fullTextZH: 你好！今天我们说一个故事
fullTextEN: Hello! Today we will tell a story.

fullTextZH: 叫王婆卖瓜(Old Lady Wang Sells Melons) 。
fullTextEN: Called Old Lady Wang Sells Melons.

fullTextZH: 然后我们说一个绕口令(tongue twister)，对
fullTextEN: Then we will say a tongue twister, right?
Okay, we will first tell a story,
There is a person
What is her name?
I don't know,

fullTextZH: 可是我知道她姓王(her surname is Wang) ，
fullTextEN: But I know her surname is Wang,
You see she is very old,
So we call her Old Lady Wang.
What does Old Lady Wang do for work?
Right, Old Lady Wang sells things,
What does she sell?
She sells melons,
Right, melons
Maybe watermelons,
She also sells flowers, right, flowers.

fullTextZH: 王婆安静地(quietly)卖她的瓜和她的花吗？
fullTextEN: Does Old Lady Wang quietly sell her melons and her flowers?
No,
Old Lady Wang likes to talk,
What does Granny Wang say?

fullTextZH: 王婆喜欢说她的瓜很好，
fullTextEN: Granny Wang likes to say her melons are very good,
Her flowers are also very good. Yes,
Granny Wang likes to promote her melons,
Granny Wang likes to promote her flowers,
Granny Wang said: "Come and see
my melons are very big!
Very sweet and very cheap!
Yes, my melons are big and cheap,
and sweet!
Come, come, come, come,
come buy my melons."
Then Granny Wang said: "
Come and see
my flowers are very beautiful,
Look, my flowers are very beautiful
and very cheap, yes,
my flowers are both beautiful
and cheap, come, come, come,
come buy my flowers."
Yes, Wang Po said her melons are very good,
Wang Po also said his flowers are very good.
But is anyone coming?
No, no one is coming, yes,

fullTextZH: 没有人理(pay attention to)王婆。
fullTextEN: No one pays attention to Wang Po.
Is Wang Po sad?
No, Wang Po is not sad,
Wang Po is still laughing, yes,
Wang Po is still very happy.

fullTextZH: 好，所以今天我们说了一个故事
fullTextEN: Okay, so today we told a story
about Wang Po selling melons and flowers,
She likes to keep talking and talking,
Her melons are very good,
Her flowers are also very good,
But no one comes to buy,
But Wang Po is not sad,
She is still laughing.
Yes,

fullTextZH: 现在我们来试试这个绕口令(tongue twister) ，
fullTextEN: Now let's try this tongue twister,
The first time we will say it slowly,
Let's say it faster the second time.
Okay, say it slowly the first time,
Now let's say it faster.
Okay,

fullTextZH: 这就是今天的故事和今天的绕口令 ，
fullTextEN: This is today's story and today's tongue twister,
Did you learn it?

fullTextZH: 如果一个人很喜欢自夸(brag) ，
fullTextEN: If a person likes to brag,
likes to say they are great,
for example, someone cooks
and then says: 'Oh!'
I cook really well,
so delicious.' Then you can say:

fullTextZH: 哎呀！你真的是‘“王婆卖瓜’，自卖自夸-ring one's own bell。”
fullTextEN: Oh! You really are 'Wang Po selling melons, self-praise'.
Do you understand?
If you understand
leave me an example.
Okay, thank you!
See you next time, bye-bye!
